plain_text:
William Gargan appears in 62 recordings across 4 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1939 to 1955. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear William Gargan most often in Barrie Craig, Lux Radio Theatre, Obsession, and Old Gold Comedy Theater.

Characters credited here include Barrie Craig.
